Class InstructorRecruitmentsController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.InstructorRecruitmentsController
@RequestMapping("/api/instructor/recruitments") @RestController public class InstructorRecruitmentsController extends ApiController
What an instructor sees on the home page (issue #127): the recruitments that include a course they teach, each with its list of their courses.

The match goes through the catalog: an instructor's email maps to the name the course catalog uses for them (issue #120, set by an admin), and each recruitment course row records the catalog name of its instructor of record. An instructor with no catalog name yet matches nothing.
